title: How can misplaced Blueprint claims move without losing substance?
question: How can misplaced Blueprint claims move without losing substance?
answer: BPR-8D: Rewriting the Blueprint requires a complete claim-level disposition: destination claims stay; architectural decisions and rationale go to active ADRs; scoped requirements and delivery state to Specs; procedures to RUNBOOK; terms and routes to LEXICON; evidence and release history to their existing owners. Verify content in its proper owner before removal, keep lineage and supersession; 'nothing is discarded merely for tidiness'.
